scripts: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS MODE_HISTORY_DATA_TABLE (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, operType TEXT, ruleName TEXT, modeId TEXT, priority INTEGER, timestamp INTEGER, configId TEXT UNIQUE ON CONFLICT REPLACE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS MODE_DATA_TABLE (modeId TEXT PRIMARY KEY, modeName TEXT, iconId TEXT, iconColor TEXT, filletIcon TEXT, roundIcon TEXT, isSupportDelete INTEGER, modePriority INTEGER, updateTime INTEGER, createTime INTEGER);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS MODE_CONFIG_DATA_TABLE (configId TEXT PRIMARY KEY, modeId TEXT, configType INTEGER, configValue TEXT, updateTime INTEGER, createTime INTEGER);
